unified_features.name: Idempotent order payment
unified_features.rationale: A single payment path for orders. The source's pay() is kept for its job but rebuilt, because its fallback key and missing timeout handling can charge twice or leave a charged order unpaid.
unified_features.behaviour: pay(order_id, key) charges the order's amount_cents through the gateway adapter. The key is required and bound to one order; the first attempt's key is recorded before the gateway is called and reused on every retry, so one order produces at most one gateway charge. A paid order is never charged again. A gateway timeout is retried once with the same key; if still unknown the order stays pending and the error is raised. Paid state, charge id and the ledger charge entry are written in one atomic write.
unified_features.improvements: No str(id(order)) fallback key; key-to-order binding; attempt key persisted before the call; timeout retry with the same key; integer cents; atomic write

unified_features.name: Exactly-once gateway webhooks
unified_features.rationale: Webhooks keep orders in step with the gateway; the source applied every delivery again and ignored the event type.
unified_features.behaviour: handle_webhook(event) records the event id in the same atomic write as its effect, so a redelivery does nothing. charge.succeeded moves a pending order to paid (and refunds a charge that lands on an order cancelled meanwhile); charge.refunded moves a paid order to refunded. Unknown types and unknown orders are ignored; duplicates of an effect already applied (same charge already recorded, order already refunded) change nothing.
unified_features.improvements: Event-id dedupe; type-aware handling; no backwards moves; ledger entry at most once per money movement

unified_features.name: Subscription renewal
unified_features.rationale: B's core loop; it creates orders through the unified order service instead of an injected callback.
unified_features.behaviour: renew(subscription, period) creates one pending order for the subscription's customer and price_cents; renewing the same subscription id for the same period returns the existing order. The monthly trigger stays outside the module.
unified_features.improvements: Per-period duplicate check (one order per subscription per period)

unified_features.name: Order lifecycle
unified_features.rationale: C's four states become the single order status, replacing A's paid flag.
unified_features.behaviour: status is one of pending, paid, cancelled, refunded; allowed moves: pending to paid, pending to cancelled, paid to refunded, cancelled to refunded (a late charge refunded). refunded is final. Any other move is refused.
unified_features.improvements: Explicit transition table enforced on every write

unified_features.name: Cancel with refund
unified_features.rationale: C's cancel kept, with the refund the user asked for.
unified_features.behaviour: cancel(order_id): pending becomes cancelled; paid is refunded through the gateway exactly once and becomes refunded with a ledger refund entry; cancelling a cancelled or refunded order is a no-op. The refund intent is written before the gateway call; a refund whose outcome is unknown is never re-sent automatically, and a charge.refunded webhook completes it.
unified_features.improvements: Refund on cancel of a paid order; idempotent cancel; refund intent written first

unified_features.name: Money ledger
unified_features.rationale: Requested by the user; it records the money movements of U01, U02 and U05.
unified_features.behaviour: ledger() lists {order_id, kind: charge|refund, amount_cents} in order of occurrence; entries are written in the same atomic write as the order change, at most one charge and one refund per order.

unified_features.name: Orders
unified_features.rationale: Requested by the user; B's renewal and every payment feature need a way to create and read orders.
unified_features.behaviour: create_order(customer, amount_cents) validates input (non-empty customer, positive integer cents) and stores a pending order; order(order_id) returns {status, amount_cents, charge_id}. A failed write creates nothing.
